definitions.supplemental: Cf. (?) for-liger for the sense in which clinicus has been taken.

quotations.old_english: Wrǽne fortyhtigend (-tiht- corruptor, Hpt. Gl. 484, 56) petulcus incestator i. maculator

source_text: for-tyhtend, -igend, es; m. A seducer, an unchaste person :-- Wrǽne fortyhtigend (-tiht- corruptor, Hpt. Gl. 484, 56) petulcus incestator i. maculator, An. Ox. 3337. Fortihtend clinice, i. lectus tetrus, Wrt. Voc. ii. 131, 71, [Cf. (?) for-liger for the sense in which clinicus has been taken.] v. preceding word.
